sample.question:
You may change exactly one sensor setting before package P1 enters. Which setting sends it to the reject bin?
Options:
[1] set S2 shape to square
[2] set S1 color to yellow
[3] set S1 color to red
[4] set S1 color to blue
[5] set S2 shape to triangle
[6] set S2 shape to circle
sample.analysis: Package P1 is red circle. Applying 'set S1 color to blue' gives sensors {'S1_color': 'blue', 'S2_shape': 'triangle'}. The route becomes feeder -> S1 -> reject and ends at reject bin. Therefore choose option 4.

rules: Packages enter S1 first. If package color matches the S1 color sensor, it goes to S2; otherwise it goes to the reject bin.
At S2, if package shape matches the S2 shape sensor, it goes to the shape-match bin; otherwise it goes to the color-only bin.
